title: Quiche Lorraine
description: A traditional France dish made with shortcrust pastry, bacon, chicken egg, heavy cream. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 7 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Pour the bacon-and-cream custard into the pastry shell and bake at 180°C until lightly golden and set in the center; rest before slicing.
